[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Chia Seed Pudding: Mix chia seeds with almond milk and let it sit overnight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Green Tea and Whole Grain Toast with Almond Butter: Start with a cup of green tea and pair it with whole grain toast and almond butter.
